fields.subject: ArgentSea.Orleans.Pg ArgentSeaOrleansMembershipTable writes
fields.condition: InsertRow or UpdateRow is invoked with a TableVersion (and, for UpdateRow, the member row's etag)
fields.trigger: the wtr.orleans_cluster_insert_member_v1 or wtr.orleans_cluster_update_member_v1 procedure runs
fields.response: the procedure compares the stored table etag with TableVersion.VersionEtag in the statement that advances it by one and stamps the new etag on the written member row; UpdateRow also requires the member row's stored etag to equal the etag argument and replaces the row's suspicions with the supplied list (one entry per suspecting silo, its latest report); any mismatch, a missing row on update or an existing row on insert raises SQLSTATE AS001, which the table reports as false; every other exception is logged and propagated
fields.postcondition: each write commits its version, member and suspicion changes entirely or not at all; of several writers starting from one read exactly one succeeds; a member etag may lag the table etag
